ui.label: Example card
ui.description: Plugin SDK template for a new question card. tools/plugin_sdk.py new renames plugin_key/config_key ('example_card') for you; the question type ('example-question', hyphenated per convention -- see manifest.py's _QUESTION_TYPE_PATTERN) must still be renamed by hand in this manifest, plugin.py, and card.js, since it must be globally unique across every card plugin.
